Hi guys, my name's Flare. I'm a pianist who's been studying music for 10 years. I currently run a site to host accurate sheet music transcriptions of various songs, which you can find here.

The reason I started doing this is because many songs which I enjoyed playing I found didn't have sheet music available for other people to learn from, or if it did, the sheets were often incredibly inaccurate. So what I do is learn the song by ear, and transcribe as many of the individual notes as possible, to as high a degree of accuracy as I can manage. This means, for example, that I do NOT merely notate chords, but every note as played, and not just the main melodic line, but all the notes that form its harmony as well.

Which brings me to the next point; you may notice that as of this posting, I only have four songs transcribed on the site. The reality is that without specific people requesting things, I'm only putting up sheets for songs as I decide to do them, which means I have very little motivation to put a lot of work into it. So what I'd like to do is get requests for songs to transcribe from you guys. Here's a rundown of guidelines for what songs I prefer doing:

First, I have to like the piece, obviously. I’m not doing something that I don’t like. Second, it has to be something that won’t already have an accurate transcription available to the public. This means two things, either the song is too complex for most musicians to handle it, or it’s too obscure for most musicians to know and do something about it. Sometimes just one, sometimes both. Exceptions can be made, though, so don’t be shy with your requests!

As an example, this is the kind of song which I'd be quite motivated to transcribe: not particularly well-known, and too complex for your average musician to parse, while this is not, as while it's part of a niche genre of games it's still extremely simplistic and easy to learn, and people have already transcribed it.

While I obviously am partial towards solo piano songs for transcription, I'm open to requests for almost any kind of song. I don't mind if it's an ensemble piece as I can score each instrument individually as well, and I can pick up notation for things like drums, violin, or guitar.

I publish all my sheets in two formats: PDF and MusicXML (.mxl). Other formats are also available on request, and I'll see what I can do.

I think that's about it, so any questions/songs you'd like me to do?
